# Abdul Baari Davids

> Personal blog of Abdul Baari Davids, a software engineer from Cape Town, South Africa, working at Entelect. Writes about applied AI, LLM engineering, software careers in South Africa, and Formula 1.

## Posts

- [Becoming an Entelectual: The Entelect Graduate Programme Experience](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/entelect-bootcamp-2026/): What the Entelect graduate programme bootcamp is like: eight weeks in Joburg as a junior software engineer in South Africa, from onboarding to client-ready.
- [Context engineering is memory management](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/context-engineering/): Your agent had the right page and still got the answer wrong. That's a memory problem, not a prompt problem.
- [Ten Laws of AI-Augmented Engineering](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/ten-ai-rules/): Ten rules I follow when building with AI, covering planning, building, verifying and keeping a codebase healthy.
- [AI in the solution, not just the SDLC](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/ai-solution-vs-sdlc/): Using AI to build software is not the same as building software that uses AI. The second one is where the real upside is, and where the hard problems live.
- [Treat your prompts like code](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/on-prompting/): Prompt engineering is testing, not magic phrases. 
- [Computer science in the intelligence age](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/ai-age/): Universities are still teaching recall. They should be teaching how to build. Thoughts from someone stuck in both worlds.
- [All aboard the AI hype train!](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/artificial-intelligence/): Is AI actually revolutionary or just another carriage on the hype train? A look at the hype, how LLMs work, and where the bubble might be.
- [Ferrari mess-ups 2024](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/ferrari-2024/): Ferrari's 2024 season, race by race: a promo video with a slow pitstop, Box Box shenanigans, and enough 'we are checking' to fill Maranello's car park.
- [My Experience as a SDE Intern at Codeinfinity](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/codeinfinity/): My software development internship at CodeInfinity: learning PHP and Python frameworks, researching a Gmail extension for a client, and getting my first real pull request merged.
- [An Introduction](https://abduldavids.co.za/posts/hello-there/): An introduction to software engineering
